📢 WE ARE HIRING | CA / CA INTER – MANAGER (AUDIT, TAX & COMPLIANCE)

C S Bhatiya & Associates, Chartered Accountants | Pune

We are looking for an experienced CA / CA Inter professional with mandatory prior experience of working in a Chartered Accountancy firm to join us in a key managerial role.

This is a hands-on, long-term position for a professional who can take ownership of assignments, manage the team and gradually assume greater responsibility in the firm.

The selected candidate will work directly with the Proprietor and will be responsible for managing day-to-day assignments, supervising junior staff / article assistants, reviewing their work, independently handling clients and ensuring timely completion of audits and statutory compliances.
Key Responsibilities

• Manage, allocate, supervise and review the work of junior staff and article assistants

• Independently manage multiple client assignments and statutory deadlines

• Handle GST compliances including returns, reconciliations, registrations, refunds and related matters

• Handle Income Tax & TDS compliances, ITRs, advance tax, tax audits and related assignments

• Handle liaisoning with GST and Income Tax authorities, including notices, submissions, hearings and departmental matters

• Conduct Internal Audit visits at client locations, identify process/control gaps and assist in preparation and discussion of audit reports

• Handle Bank Audits, including Branch Audits, Concurrent Audits, Stock Audits and other assignments, as applicable

• Handle / supervise Tax Audits, Statutory Audits and other assurance assignments

• Review books of accounts, ledger scrutiny, reconciliations and finalisation of accounts

• Directly coordinate with clients and resolve routine accounting, taxation and compliance matters

• Monitor overall status of assignments and report key matters directly to the Proprietor

• Personally execute critical GST, Income Tax, Audit and compliance assignments whenever required
Candidate Requirements

🎓 CA / CA Inter / Semi-Qualified CA

🏢 Prior working experience in a CA Firm is MANDATORY

💼 Strong practical knowledge of GST, Income Tax, TDS, Accounting, Finalisation & Audit

🔍 Practical exposure to Internal Audits and Bank Audits

🏛️ Experience in dealing with GST / Income Tax authorities will be preferred

👥 Ability to manage, train and guide junior team members

🤝 Ability to independently manage clients and take ownership of assignments

💻 Good working knowledge of Tally and MS Excel

🗣️ Good communication, drafting and client-handling skills

🚗 Willingness to travel for client visits, Internal Audits, Bank Audits and departmental work
⭐ Long-Term Growth & Partnership Opportunity

We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the firm over the long term, rather than restrict themselves to a routine compliance role.

A candidate who demonstrates strong technical competence, integrity, ownership, client-management ability, leadership skills and consistent performance will be given increasing responsibilities within the practice.

For a qualified Chartered Accountant, there may also be an opportunity to progress towards Partnership in the firm, subject to performance, mutual suitability and long-term association.

This role can therefore develop from Manager → Senior Management → Potential Partner, based on the individual's contribution and capabilities.

📍 Location: Pune

🏢 C S Bhatiya & Associates, Chartered Accountants

💼 Position: Manager – Audit, Tax & Compliance

💰 Compensation: Commensurate with qualification, experience and practical capabilities

📩 Interested candidates may DM their CV on LinkedIn.

Role description

About the Department

The Finance Operations department in the company handles all the financial and investment decisions. It primarily focuses on maximizing shareholder value through long-term and short-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. It aims to maximize the value of a business through the planning and execution of resources.
The Role &

Responsibilities The Executive Vice President - Order to Cash / Accounts Receivable will lead TresVista’s end-to-end revenue-to-cash agenda, with ownership across invoicing, collections, credit risk, revenue assurance, pricing insights, customer contract inputs, cash forecasting, and O2C transformation. This is a high-impact, customer-facing leadership role requiring strong commercial judgement, business acumen, analytical depth, and the ability to partner with stakeholders across Commercial, Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Product, and business leadership.

Beyond traditional AR accounting, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, statutory audit support, DSO calculation, and transaction governance, the role will be expected to create measurable business value by anticipating risks, solving structural issues, improving cash predictability, and using technology, dashboards, automation, AI/RPA, and analytics to build a scalable O2C operating model.

Key Role Deliverables:

• Commercial Finance, Revenue Insights & Pricing Governance

• Partner with business and commercial teams to evaluate pricing models, cost inflators, customer discounts, sales commissions, CAC, customer lifetime value, ARR, and revenue added by channel/product

• Provide analytical insights on churn, customer loyalty, customer profitability, customer behavior, and revenue leakage to support strategic decision-making

• Act as a core member of the pricing committee and provide inputs on price structuring, discount governance, customer viability, renewal economics, and commercial risk.

Customer Contracts, Churn Mitigation & Legal Partnership

• Participate in the customer contract committee and advise on payment terms, collection enforceability, contract risk, churn triggers, discounting terms, and revenue protection clauses

• Work closely with Legal to resolve overdue accounts, contract disputes, collection challenges, and escalations requiring formal recovery or negotiation

• Develop mitigation practices to reduce churn, improve customer stickiness, and strengthen contract hygiene across new and existing client relationships.

Collections, International Banking & Treasury Partnership

• Lead timely collections across geographies by addressing customer-side issues, banking delays, failed payment flows, international remittance challenges, and process bottlenecks

• Partner with Treasury for cash forecasting, liquidity visibility, collection predictability, auto-collection mechanisms, and banking process improvements

• Own DSO, CEI, ageing movement, overdue reduction, unapplied cash, and collection-risk reporting with clear governance and escalation rhythm

• Digital Transformation, AI/RPA & Control Tower

• Build a digital-first O2C operating model through dashboards, RPA workflows, AI-enabled anomaly detection, auto-matching, cash application automation, and revenue/cash forecasting models

• Create exception-based control towers for invoice accuracy, collections risk, pricing exceptions, contract-related disputes, write-offs, credit memos, and customer-level exposure

• Drive business cases and ROI for collections platforms, EIPP/portals, cash application ML/IDP, workflow automation, and analytics-led decision support

• O2C Operations, Revenue Accounting & Controls

• Own end-to-end AR/O2C operations including billing accuracy, client invoicing, collections, cash application, credit notes, write-off governance, revenue accounting, revenue gap assessment, and statutory audit support

• Strengthen controls around onboarding, KYC, credit limits, segregation of duties, audit trails, billing accuracy, tax/e-invoicing readiness, and revenue handoffs

• Establish process discipline across customer master data, payment terms, dispute SLAs, credit governance, closing activities, and audit evidence readiness

• M&A, New Service Lines & Geographic Expansion Support

• Support due diligence for M&A, acquire opportunities, new service lines, new geographies, and new end markets by evaluating customer contracts, revenue quality, receivables, collection risks, and integration readiness

• Standardize customer master data, collection policies, payment terms, and O2C controls where new entities, products, markets, or customer portfolios are integrated into TresVista’s operating model

• Stakeholder Management & Leadership Rhythm

• Partner across Legal, Treasury, Corporate Finance, Commercial, Product, business teams, and leadership to identify risks early, solve cross-functional issues, and drive accountable outcomes

• Run weekly exception and ageing reviews, monthly CFO/commercial reviews, and leadership packs covering cash, risk, churn, customer health, and transformation progress

Decision Rights

• Recommend and approve O2C credit, collections, customer contract, and e-billing governance standards in partnership with relevant stakeholders

• Prioritize the O2C automation roadmap, exception dashboards, workflow releases, and transformation initiatives in collaboration with IT and business teams

• Drive escalation decisions for overdue accounts, customer exposure, policy exceptions, and credit risk mitigation actions

• Propose transformation investments, vendor/platform requirements, ROI cases, and operating model changes for revenue-to-cash scalability

Success Measures (KPIs)

• Reduction in DSO, overdue balances, delinquency movement, write-offs, and unresolved disputes

• Improvement in CEI, timely collections, cash forecast accuracy, and customer-level collection predictability

• First-pass invoice accuracy, billing cycle-time reduction, reduction in pricing/contract/tax-related rework, and faster audit evidence turnaround

• Improvement in ARR visibility, ARR added by channel/product, churn insights, discount governance, customer lifetime value understanding, and revenue leakage prevention

• Automation adoption, cash application auto-match percentage, anomaly detection effectiveness, dashboard adoption, and measurable transformation ROI

• Improved stakeholder satisfaction across commercial, legal, treasury, finance, product, and leadership teams

Prerequisites:

• Chartered Accountant with 8 to 14 years of experience across Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, revenue accounting, commercial finance, credit risk, collections, or transformation-led finance operations

• Strong commercial and business acumen with the ability to connect invoicing, collections, pricing, contracts, customer behavior, churn, revenue forecasting, and cash forecasting

• Customer-facing mindset with strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics/D365, or equivalent finance platforms; exposure to Power BI/control towers, collection platforms, EIPP/portals, AI/RPA, cash application automation, or workflow tools will be preferred

• Strong understanding of international banking, collections, customer contracting, credit policy, revenue controls, SOX/ICFR, statutory audit support, and multi-entity/multi-jurisdiction operations

• High analytical orientation with advanced Excel/reporting capability and the ability to convert data into insights, actions, and business decisions

• Demonstrated ability to anticipate problems, design mitigation plans, solve cross-functional issues, and operate effectively in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

• Self-driven, detail-oriented, proactive, entrepreneurial, and willing to build scalable processes while continuing to learn and grow.

Ideal Candidate Profile

• CA with 8 to 14 years of experience, preferably in a high-growth services, consulting, SaaS, technology-enabled, or global managed-services environment.

• Proven leadership in O2C/AR, collections, revenue assurance, credit governance, customer contracts, pricing analytics, cash forecasting, and commercial finance advisory

• Experience working directly with customers and senior internal stakeholders to resolve collection, pricing, contract, and revenue-related issues

• Strong transformation orientation with exposure to dashboards, AI/RPA, anomaly detection, cash forecasting, revenue forecasting, auto-collection, and automation-led finance operating models

• Ability to think strategically and critically while remaining hands-on in execution, controls, governance, and stakeholder follow-through.

Compensation The compensation structure will be as per industry standards
